candidates: When adding a TODO comment in source or test code, make it actionable: briefly describe what needs to be done and/or include a link to a tracking issue (e.g., 'TODO: cover edge-case X, see #1234'). Do not use personal name callouts such as 'TODO: <Name> figure this out' — they are not actionable for future contributors.

Never use `console.log` (or other direct `console.*` methods) in renderer or utility code. Replace any such calls with the project logger imported from `storybook/internal/node-logger` (e.g., `logger.debug(...)`) at an appropriate level, or remove the log entirely. Direct console usage leaks internal paths and violates the project's logging conventions.
